sources.title: dataR: Baufortschritt in Bildern (construction progress in pictures), August 2026 section with aerial construction-site photographs dated 2026-08-27
sources.summary: dataR's own post 'Baufortschritt in Bildern' ('Hier dokumentieren wir unseren Baufortschritt in Bildern': here we document our construction progress in pictures) on its Rellingen data-centre project shows the post date 2026-09-01 and month sections from 'Die Anfänge' (January 2024) to 'August 2026'. The newest section, 'August 2026', holds 16 aerial photographs whose operator file names all begin with the date 2026-08-27 and describe the construction site ('dataR_Baustelle-von-oben', for example Front-2, Blickrichtung Nord, Ost and Sued-Rueckseite, Rueckseite-auf-Kransicht, Zufahrt-TG). Two of them were captured and viewed (supporting_captures): they show the data-centre building with rooftop cooling units and exhaust stacks in place while a tower crane, site cabins and site fencing are still on the plot, i.e. a construction site that is not yet handed over. Every earlier section uses the same file-name convention with dates inside its month (for example 2026-07-02 and 2026-07-20 under 'Juli 2026', 2026-06-19 under 'Juni 2026'); the 'September 2025' and 'November 2025' headings are swapped relative to their file dates (2025-11-22 and 2025-09-01), an operator labelling slip that does not affect the 2026 sections.
sources.date_semantics: Observation date 2026-08-27 is the photograph date the operator writes into each file name of the 'August 2026' section; the images sit in the September 2026 media folder (wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2026/09/). published_at 2026-09-01 is the post date shown on the page (Elementor post-info, itemprop datePublished '2026-09-01'), in dataR's news index ('Baufortschritt in Bildern - 1. September 2026') and in its RSS feed (pubDate Tue, 01 Sep 2026 12:34:42 +0000); the WordPress post sitemap gives lastmod 2026-09-01 and lists no later post. The post also carries the older month sections, so 2026-09-01 is the date of this version of the gallery, not the start of construction. Retrieval on 23 October 2026 is not an observation.

supporting_captures.note: Aerial view of the street front: building with yellow-framed windows, rooftop cooling plant and stacks, tower crane behind, site fencing.

Aerial view of the rear: rooftop chiller rows and generator stacks, crane jib in the foreground, site containers on the plot. The JPEG EXIF holds no capture date; the date comes from the operator's file name.
News index: 'Baufortschritt in Bildern' dated 1. September 2026 is the newest item, followed by 10 August, 17 July and 29 April 2026.
RSS feed: newest item 'Baufortschritt in Bildern', pubDate Tue, 01 Sep 2026 12:34:42 +0000.
Post sitemap: newest lastmod 2026-09-01 (this post); no post modified later.
